label: Ecobee Smart Thermostat Premium
description: Ecobee Smart Thermostat Premium controls 24 VAC HVAC (up to 2H/2C plus heat pump), adds occupancy radar, air-quality monitoring and an ecobee Smart Security hub role. It is WiFi-only: dual-band 802.11 b/g/n at 2.4 GHz and 802.11 a/n/ac at 5 GHz plus Bluetooth 5.0; the wall wiring is HVAC control (Rc, C, W, Y, G), not Ethernet, so it has no RJ45 and must join a wireless SSID.
